title: Wound Care Dressing Item Schedule: Weekly Change Limits and Cash Prices
content:
# Dressing item schedule — Wound Care Supply Program

The Wound Care Supply Program supplies the dressing items below. The same schedule applies on all six tiers.

| Item code | Most dressing changes per wound per week the tier covers | Larkfield cash price per dressing | Primary dressing that needs a secondary cover dressing on the same order |
|---|---|---|---|
| A6196 | 7 | USD 6.45 | Yes |
| A6209 | 3 | USD 5.90 | No |
| A6212 | 3 | USD 7.15 | No |
| A6234 | 3 | USD 5.30 | No |
| A6237 | 3 | USD 6.85 | No |
| A6242 | 7 | USD 4.95 | Yes |
| A6257 | 3 | USD 1.85 | No |
| A6203 | 3 | USD 3.40 | No |
| A6402 | 21 | USD 0.32 | Yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- The three items marked Yes in the last column (A6196, A6242 and A6402) are the primary dressings that need a secondary cover dressing on the same order — the alginate, hydrogel without border and gauze dressings.
- The weekly figure is counted per wound: it states the most dressing changes per wound per week the tier covers.
- The cash price is per dressing, in USD.

## Reading a row (hypothetical order)

A hypothetical order of 14 dressings of item A6234 at the cash price of USD 5.30 per dressing has a cash-price total of USD 74.20. Item A6234 carries a weekly figure of 3 changes per wound and is not marked as needing a secondary cover dressing.
